name: viva-inteligencia
description: MVP cloud-agnostic de inteligencia comercial para Viva Inmobiliaria.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @viva/contracts && npm run build --workspace @viva/domain && npm run build --workspace @viva/snapshot
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @viva/api && npm run build --workspace @viva/web
scripts.check: npm run build:packages && npm run check --workspace @viva/contracts && npm run check --workspace @viva/domain && npm run check --workspace @viva/snapshot && npm run check --workspace @viva/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @viva/web && npm run check --workspace @viva/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @viva/contracts && npm run test --workspace @viva/domain && npm run test --workspace @viva/snapshot && npm run test --workspace @viva/api && npm run test:architecture --workspace @viva/web && npm run test:scenario --workspace @viva/web && npm run test:comparability --workspace @viva/web && npm run test:inspector:domain --workspace @viva/web && npm run test:benchmark:domain --workspace @viva/web && npm run test:history:domain --workspace @viva/web && npm run test:assistant:domain --workspace @viva/web
scripts.e2e:product: npm run data:build && npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @viva/api && node tests/e2e/productized-e2e.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run data:build && npm run check && npm run test && npm run e2e && npm run build && npm audit --audit-level=high
